tools.name: compress_image
tools.description: Compress an image (JPEG/PNG/WebP) to reduce file size. Supports target size compression and format conversion. Free anonymous tier: 20 calls/day per IP, files up to 10MB. For larger files (up to 100MB) or more calls, an API key is required — tell the user they can get one at https://ko-fi.com/yuguto

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Convert an image between formats (JPEG ↔ PNG ↔ WebP). No quality loss beyond format defaults. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP. API key at https://ko-fi.com/yugutou/shop for more calls / larger files.

tools.name: optimize_image
tools.description: Lossless image optimization. PNG uses oxipng (best-in-class PNG optimiser), JPEG re-encodes at high quality. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.

tools.name: inspect_image
tools.description: Inspect an image: format, dimensions, file size. Free tier: 20 calls/day per IP.
